shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Optional card at rest. Neutral, not a glow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action. Market Green, white label, 44px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #146B45; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0E5436; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146B45; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter action beside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFCF7; color: #1C1917; font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #E4DDD2; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #146B45; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146B45; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #146B45; font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #E7F5EE; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146B45; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A product or content surface. Flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFCF7; color: #1C1917; border: 1px solid #E4DDD2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 25 23 / 0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Rubik, Nunito Sans, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-price { font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field. Focus is a green border, not a glow.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search the shop" aria-label="Search the shop" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFCF7; color: #1C1917; font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #E4DDD2; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146B45; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #146B45; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: A short status pill. Green text on paper.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #F6F3EC; color: #0E5436; font-family: Nunito Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
ShopMart should feel like a well-kept market stall just after opening: fresh food, a clear price, and enough quiet to decide. The green is the awning. The paper is warm, not hospital white. Nothing shouts.

Density stays comfortable on a phone. One primary action per band. Product photos carry the color; the chrome stays calm. Light and dark are the same shop at different times of day.
keyCharacteristics: Green brand, warm paper, near-black ink
Rubik for headings, Nunito Sans for reading and UI
Soft corners, hairline borders, shadows that barely lift
One easing curve, short durations, still when reduced motion is on
PKR prices and lucide icons, always

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Brand green covers actions and identity. It does not flood backgrounds. A screen is mostly paper and photos.

rules.name: The No Gray-on-Green Rule
rules.body: Never put muted gray type on a green, clay, warning, or danger fill. Labels on those fills are white or Lamp (#F4F1EA).

rules.name: The Price Rule
rules.body: A price is body or title size, tabular figures, prefixed Rs. with a thousands separator. Never $.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Product cards do not float, tilt, or glow on hover.

dos: Do take every color, radius, and font from this frontmatter.
Do keep white labels on Market Green and Leaf Shade.
Do use one hover change on a product card: a second photo or a quiet border.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by dropping movement and keeping opacity or instant state.
donts: Don't use purple gradients, gold (#D4AF37 and kin), neon, or the current luxury theme tokens.
Don't use glassmorphism, liquid glass, or blur as a default surface.
Don't use bounce, overshoot, or glow shadows.
Don't nest cards, put gray text on a colored fill, or use emoji as icons.
Don't load fonts from a third-party stylesheet in the app.
